format: Free-Standing Arby's Restaurant (Traditional, leased scenario, Inspire image), excluding purchase of land/building

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of an Arby's Restaurant franchise is from $868,550 to $2,456,600 for a Free-Standing Arby's Restaurant and from $651,550 to $1,379,600 for a Non-Free-Standing Arby's Restaurant. This includes $12,500 to $56,300 that must be paid to the franchisor or affiliate.

fee.quote: Standard Traditional Restaurant $12,500 $37,500 Non-Traditional Restaurant $0 $18,750 Standard Incentive $12,500 $0
fee.note: Standard Traditional Restaurant: $37,500 franchise fee plus a separate $12,500 non-refundable Development Fee per Restaurant (not credited toward the franchise fee). Under the Standard incentive (new Development Agreement by March 31, 2027) the franchise fee is waived ($0), with a $7,500 Royalty credit. Training fee currently $2,100 per attendee (expected $4,000 mid-year), waived for 2 managers of the first Restaurant.

royalty.quote: Royalty Fee 4% of Gross Sales, subject to applicable incentives.1, 2 6.2% of Gross Sales for Non-Traditional Restaurants.1, 2 Payable monthly on or before the 10th day of the following month.

adFund.quote: Advertising and Marketing Service Fee Currently a minimum aggregate expenditure of 5.2% of Gross Sales comprised of this fee, Local Market Advertising, and Local Cooperative Area Advertising (if applicable) ... which currently ranges from 3.22% to 5% of Gross Sales for Traditional Restaurants.
adFund.note: Total minimum advertising spend 5.2% of Gross Sales: AFA Advertising and Marketing Service Fee 3.22% to 5% (tiered) plus local market/cooperative spending of 0.2% to 1.98%. Local Cooperative Area Advertising generally 3% to 7%. Standard incentive: 75% discount on the service fee years 1-3, 50% year 4 (minimum 0.85%). Royalty under Standard incentive: 0.5% year 1, 1.0% years 2-4, 2.0% year 5, 4.0% thereafter.

otherRecurring.name: Learning Management System fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently $62.99 plus tax per year for each Arby's Restaurant

otherRecurring.name: Arby's Order Ahead Platform Service Fee (optional)
otherRecurring.amount: $50 per restaurant per month; 4% of Gross Sales on each order ahead order (35¢ minimum, $1.25 maximum); 3% of Gross Sales from third-party delivery platforms

transferFee.amount: $17,500 for transfer of first Arby's Restaurant; $2,500 if you are already a party or hold a 50% interest in a party to at least one existing FA.
